policy.description: locator.startChar/endChar are Unicode code point indices into the NFC canonical text; hashes are SHA-256 hex over UTF-8. Cases with utf16_differs=true are must-fail witnesses for UTF-16-indexed implementations.

cases.name: ascii_basic
cases.description: Plain ASCII: code points == UTF-16 units == bytes-per-char.
cases.canonical_text: Ceza sorumlulugu sahsidir; kimse baskasinin fiilinden sorumlu tutulamaz.

cases.name: turkish_dotted_capital_i
cases.description: Dotted capital I (U+0130) and other Turkish letters; BMP only.
cases.canonical_text: Madde 2 - İdare, kuruluş ve görevleriyle bir bütündür ve kanunla düzenlenir.

cases.name: turkish_dotless_i
cases.description: Dotless i (U+0131) and dotted capital (U+0130) around the quote.
cases.canonical_text: Işık ve ısı ölçümleri sınır değerlerini aşamaz; İdare bunu denetler.

cases.name: nfc_canonical_from_nfd_input
cases.description: Canonical stored form is NFC; the NFD spelling of the same text is provided so validators can prove they normalize before slicing/hashing.
cases.canonical_text: İdarenin her türlü eylem ve işlemlerine karşı yargı yolu açıktır.
cases.nfd_source_text: İdarenin her türlü eylem ve işlemlerine karşı yargı yolu açıktır.

cases.name: emoji_prefix_utf16_trap
cases.description: One non-BMP emoji (U+1F600, a surrogate pair in UTF-16) before the quote shifts UTF-16 indices by one unit: naive UTF-16 slicing MUST fail here.
cases.canonical_text: ⚖ 😀 Mülkiyet hakkı, ancak kamu yararı amacıyla kanunla sınırlanabilir.

cases.name: multiple_astral_prefix
cases.description: Several non-BMP code points (Phoenician letters, classical building emoji) before a Turkish quote: UTF-16 offsets drift by three units.
cases.canonical_text: 𐤀𐤁 kadim yazı; 🏛 Anayasa Mahkemesi kararına göre özgürlük esastır.

cases.name: combining_mark_stays_decomposed
cases.description: q + U+0303 has no precomposed form, so NFC keeps two code points; combining marks count as their own code points.
cases.canonical_text: Sözleşme q̃ işareti ile paraflandı ve dosyaya eklendi.

cases.name: astral_inside_quote
cases.description: Non-BMP emoji INSIDE the quote: quote length in code points differs from its UTF-16 length, so both offsets and the slice width diverge for UTF-16 implementations.
cases.canonical_text: Tutanakta 📜 Kanun metni aynen alıntılandı: 'Hak arama hürriyeti engellenemez.'

cases.name: full_document_span
cases.description: Quote spans the whole canonical text (start=0, end=length).
cases.canonical_text: Hak arama hürriyeti hiçbir şekilde engellenemez.
cases.expected_quote: Hak arama hürriyeti hiçbir şekilde engellenemez.
